summary_en: Media Corp tender offer for Oricon Inc. closed July 14, 2006. Tender applicants submitted 4,101,180 shares, exceeding the minimum threshold of 1,074,100 shares. Settlement began July 11, 2006. Upon settlement completion, Media Corp's voting stake will reach 90% or more, making it a major shareholder and resulting in Oricon's delisting and privatization as Media Corp's wholly owned subsidiary.
summary_jp: メディア株式会社によるオリコン株式会社に対する公開買付けが2006年7月14日に終了。応募株式数4,101,180株が買付予定下限1,074,100株を上回り成立。7月11日決済開始。決済完了後、メディア株式会社の議決権割合が90%以上となり、完全子会社化・非公開化予定。

summary_en: Tender offer launched by Media Corp. (backed by Technoroji Inc.) to acquire Oricon Inc. at ¥1,331/share. Offer period: 23 May – 9 July 2024 (20 business days). Minimum acceptance threshold 50.10% of shares outstanding (excluding offeror's existing holdings). Purpose: take-private and delist. Board recommends acceptance; no stated premium over prior close disclosed in excerpt.
summary_jp: メディア株式会社による公開買付。買付価格1株1,331円。買付期間2024年5月23日～7月9日。最低応募条件50.10%（発行済株式総数ベース）。目的：完全子会社化・上場廃止。取締役会は応募推奨を決議。
